body:
[muse watermelon-full-preview] Landed on agent-utils main ba0d8c8bb8053e22aa96d2cbef5b9ed11f31fd6c (#770 agent-teams-relay-fallback-route + #782 agent-teams-relay-mirror, gate 27/27).

Note for later (not code now): receipt posts run receipt_argv with the fixed 10s post timeout (relay::POST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS); no route's post_timeout_seconds covers receipt_argv. If a receipt helper ever needs to wait out Slack retry_after longer than 10s, receipts will time out while accept/mirror posts (which do honour post_timeout_seconds) succeed.
